error.invalid_redirect_url: No authorization code found in the URL. Check the URL and try again.
error.code_exchange_failed: Failed to exchange the authorization code. Check your credentials and try again.
error.samsung_login_failed: Samsung Account login failed. Check your email and password. Accounts with 2FA are not supported.

user.title: Choose authentication method
user.description: Samsung deprecated indefinite SmartThings Personal Access Tokens on 2024-12-30 — new PATs expire every 24 hours. Reusing the HA core SmartThings integration's OAuth2 credentials avoids this limit entirely.

standalone_oauth_credentials.title: Standalone SmartThings OAuth — App credentials
standalone_oauth_credentials.description: Enter the client_id and client_secret from your SmartThings OAuth-In app (created via `smartthings apps:create`).

standalone_oauth_link.title: Standalone SmartThings OAuth — Authorize
standalone_oauth_link.description:
Open this URL in a browser to authorize:

`{authorization_url}`

After authorizing, paste the full redirect URL or the raw authorization code below.

standalone_oauth_samsung.title: Standalone SmartThings OAuth — Samsung Account (optional)
standalone_oauth_samsung.description:
Optionally provide Samsung Account credentials to enable IoT camera features. Leave all fields empty to skip — the integration will work without live image downloads.

{samsung_signin_client_secret_hint}

pat.title: SmartThings Personal Access Token
pat.description: Tokens created after 2024-12-30 expire every 24 hours. You will need to reauthenticate after each expiry.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate SmartThings
reauth_confirm.description: Your SmartThings token has expired. Please enter a new Personal Access Token.

reauth_standalone_oauth.title: Re-authenticate SmartThings (Standalone OAuth)
reauth_standalone_oauth.description: Enter your SmartThings app's client ID and secret.

reauth_standalone_oauth_link.title: Authorize SmartThings
reauth_standalone_oauth_link.description:
Open this URL in a browser to authorize:

`{authorization_url}`

Then paste the full redirect URL or the authorization code below.

init.title: Samsung FamilyHub Options
init.description: Configure companion token rotator endpoints and Food Circles settings.

data.rotator_api_key: Rotator API key (if the rotator requires one)
data.food_update_interval: Food Circles sync interval in seconds
data.poll_interval: Fridge status poll interval in seconds (10-3600, default 60)

refresh.name: Refresh camera
refresh.description: Ask the fridge to take new camera photos. Capture happens on door-close events; this sends the same command, and the result depends on the fridge's state and firmware.

config_entry_id.name: Fridge
config_entry_id.description: Which fridge to refresh. Leave empty to refresh all.

refresh_food_inventory.name: Refresh food inventory
refresh_food_inventory.description: Immediately re-read the fridge's food inventory.

config_entry_id.name: Fridge
config_entry_id.description: Which fridge to refresh. Leave empty to refresh all.

auth_failed.message: SmartThings rejected the credentials. Re-authenticate the integration.

rate_limited.message: SmartThings is rate limiting requests. Try again shortly.

no_loaded_entry.message: No loaded Samsung FamilyHub entry matches.

no_food_inventory.message: The food inventory is not set up (no Samsung Food token was found).

no_token.message: This entry has no SmartThings token and the rotator did not provide one. Reconfigure the integration.

missing_credentials.message: The Standalone OAuth entry is missing credentials. Reconfigure the integration.

oauth_mode_removed.message: Borrowing the SmartThings integration's OAuth credentials is no longer supported. Reconfigure using Standalone OAuth or a Personal Access Token.
